document_metadata.title: 1、EXT. FROZEN POND - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Jack discovers a wooden staff that emits frost and wind, enabling him to glide and leap across the ice before spotting a distant town from a tree.

entities.name: Ice cracks and splits open on frozen pond
entities.description: The surface of a frozen pond begins to fracture under stress, producing audible cracking sounds until a hole violently splinters open in the ice.

entities.name: Jack Frost emerges from underwater through ice hole
entities.description: A young man, Jack Frost, floats upward out of the dark water beneath the ice, rising into the moonlight as he exits the pond.

entities.name: Jack Frost descends onto ice surface after emergence
entities.description: After emerging from the water, Jack Frost gently lowers himself back onto the surface of the frozen pond as the hole beneath him closes.

entities.name: Jack Frost experiences moment of clarity under moonlight
entities.description: Bathed in intense moonlight, Jack Frost feels a shift in emotion, no longer afraid as he perceives the moon dispelling darkness and bringing calm.

entities.name: Jack Frost looks around in confusion after awakening
entities.description: Upon landing on the ice, Jack Frost scans his surroundings with a puzzled expression, showing disorientation about his location and purpose.

entities.name: frozen pond

entities.name: night

entities.name: Jack Frost
entities.description: A young man who emerges from a frozen pond, pale and barefoot with frosted white hair, experiencing confusion and a moment of clarity under the moonlight.
entities.summary: A mischievous winter spirit with frosted hair emerges from a pond, observed by a hooded figure chosen by the Man in Moon to become a Guardian, and is later summoned to join the Guardians, linked to frost, wind, and nighttime flights.

entities.name: frosted white hair

entities.description: When the base of the staff touches the ice, frost rapidly shoots out and spreads across the surface of the frozen pond.

entities.name: Jack Frost sends frost up tree trunks using staff

document_metadata.title: 2、EXT. BURGESS SETTLEMENT - TOWN CENTER - CONTINUOUS
document_metadata.summary: Jack realizes he is invisible to villagers and recalls the moon revealing his name, Jack Frost, long ago, with no further guidance since.

entities.description: Jack approaches the settlers in the town, greeting them politely, but they walk past without acknowledging his presence.

document_metadata.title: 25、INT. NORTH'S LIBRARY - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Jack provokes Bunny by calling him a kangaroo, leading to tension; North intervenes, asking Jack to walk with him as Sandy and North acknowledge the growing conflict.

entities.name: Jack slams his staff, creating a frost and wind blast
entities.description: In response to the unfolding situation, Jack forcefully strikes the ground with his staff, releasing a surge of frost and wind that extinguishes the torches and halts ongoing activity in the room.

entities.name: Jack questions the Guardians' decision to make him a Guardian
entities.description: Jack challenges the Guardians' assumption that he wants to become one of them, expressing confusion and resistance to the idea.

entities.name: North laughs and then commands music to begin
entities.description: After Jack's outburst, North initially laughs, then abruptly stops and orders the elves to play music for a celebration.

entities.name: Elves start playing trumpets for celebration
entities.description: Following North's command, the elves begin blaring trumpets to initiate a celebratory atmosphere.

entities.name: Jack interrupts the music and demands it stop
entities.description: Jack asserts his objection to the celebration by shouting 'No music!', causing the musical performance to cease.

entities.name: An elf throws down his trumpet and storms off
entities.description: Frustrated or offended by the abrupt end to the music, one elf angrily discards his trumpet and exits the scene in protest.

entities.name: North expresses displeasure at the elf's behavior
entities.description: Observing the elf's outburst, North reacts with a disapproving glare, showing his annoyance.

entities.name: Jack explains why he does not fit the Guardian role
entities.description: Jack elaborates on his belief that he is unsuited for guardianship, contrasting his carefree nature with the Guardians' disciplined lifestyle.

entities.name: Bunny agrees with Jack's unsuitability as a Guardian
entities.description: Bunny affirms Jack's statement by agreeing that Jack is not the right fit for the Guardians, reinforcing the skepticism.

entities.name: Tooth redirects Jack's attention to the globe of believing children
entities.description: Tooth physically guides Jack to observe the massive globe, pointing out that each light represents a child who believes in the Guardians.

entities.name: Tooth examines Jack's teeth and compliments them
entities.description: While Jack is distracted, Tooth instinctively inspects his teeth, removes her fingers upon realizing the impropriety, and praises their condition.

entities.name: North explains the Guardians' duty to protect all children
entities.description: North emphasizes the Guardians' mission to safeguard every believing child regardless of behavior, underscoring the seriousness of their role.

entities.name: North declares urgency in confronting Pitch
entities.description: North ends the hesitation by asserting that Pitch is active and dangerous, calling for decisive action from the Guardians.

document_metadata.title: 27、INT. NORTH'S OFFICE - A MOMENT LATER
document_metadata.summary: A sudden disturbance outside prompts Bunny and Sandman to alert North and Jack of trouble at the Tooth Palace, leading to immediate action.

entities.name: North offers Jack a fruit cake
entities.description: North picks up a plate from a nearby elf and offers Jack a fruit cake, who declines politely.

entities.name: North hurls fruit cake against the wall
entities.description: After Jack refuses the fruit cake, North throws it forcefully, causing it to crash against the wall.

entities.name: Office door slams and locks suddenly
entities.description: The wind violently slams North's office door shut, and it locks on its own, drawing Jack's attention.

entities.name: North confronts Jack about his identity and center
entities.description: North moves close to Jack, backs him against the door, and demands to know who he is and what his center is as a Guardian.

entities.name: North pokes Jack in the chest during interrogation
entities.description: To emphasize his question, North physically pokes Jack in the chest while questioning him about his center.

entities.name: North explains his nature using nesting dolls
entities.description: North hands Jack a Russian nesting doll of himself to illustrate that he is more than just an intimidating figure, revealing layers of his personality.

entities.name: Jack opens the nesting doll to reveal smaller version
entities.description: Jack twists the outer nesting doll in half and discovers a smaller, jollier carved doll inside, representing a different aspect of North.

entities.name: North's office

entities.summary: A mischievous winter spirit with frosted hair emerges from a pond, observed by a hooded figure chosen by the Man in Moon to become a Guardian, and is later summoned to join the Guardians, linked to frost, wind, and nighttime flights.

entities.name: North
entities.description: A Guardian figure, also known as Santa Claus, who runs a workshop filled with toys and uses nesting dolls to explain his layered nature to Jack.

document_metadata.title: 32、INT. TOOTH PALACE - A MOMENT LATER
document_metadata.summary: Pitch provokes the Guardians by referencing fear and the Dark Ages, showing confidence in his power despite Bunny's defiance, as he nostalgically recalls past terror.

entities.name: North hands control of the sleigh to Jack
entities.description: North spots a threat ahead and transfers control of the sleigh reins to Jack, instructing him to take over.

entities.name: Jack takes control of the sleigh and reacts with excitement
entities.description: Jack, surprised but quick to respond, grabs the reins and snaps them with a shout, taking command of the sleigh.

entities.name: North attacks and splits the Nightmare in half
entities.description: North draws his sword and slices a Nightmare creature in half, causing it to disintegrate and release stolen tooth boxes.

entities.name: Tooth boxes spill out from the destroyed Nightmare
entities.description: After the Nightmare is cut open, numerous small wooden boxes containing teeth fall out and land in the Guardians' sleigh.

entities.name: Nightmare disintegrates into black sand
entities.description: The defeated Nightmare dissolves into black sand, which briefly forms shapes before drifting away.

entities.name: Sandy observes the black sand forming shapes
entities.description: Sandy examines the remnants of the Nightmare and sees the black sand take on transient forms before floating off.

entities.name: Sandy and Bunny exchange a concerned look
entities.description: After witnessing the sand's behavior, Sandy and Bunny silently communicate their shared worry.

entities.name: The sleigh narrowly avoids colliding with a pillar
entities.description: As the sleigh heads toward a massive pillar, Jack pulls the reins sharply, causing a near miss and a rough landing on a platform.

entities.name: Tooth expresses distress over stolen fairies and teeth
entities.description: Tooth reveals that her fairies and all the teeth in her collection have been stolen, showing visible frustration and despair.

entities.name: Tooth realizes the full extent of the loss and collapses emotionally
entities.description: After speaking, Tooth fully comprehends the magnitude of the theft and drops her wings in defeat, overwhelmed by grief.

entities.name: Guardians rush to comfort Tooth
entities.description: Seeing Tooth's emotional breakdown, the other Guardians move quickly to support and console her.

entities.name: Baby Tooth emerges and reunites with Tooth
entities.description: Jack remains behind as Baby Tooth appears from his tunic hood and flies to Tooth, who is relieved to see her.

entities.name: vast chamber supported by pillars
entities.description: A large interior space with pillars and filled with wooden deposit boxes, serving as the setting for the confrontation with the Nightmare and its aftermath.

entities.name: platform
entities.description: A designated stopping area where the sleigh comes to rest after narrowly avoiding a collision with a pillar.

entities.name: North
entities.description: A Guardian who hands over control of the sleigh to Jack and later warns him about the pillar, showing leadership and concern during the crisis.
entities.summary: Guardians convene at the North Pole after an urgent summons regarding Pitch Black's return and the threat to children, while a central figure works on an ice locomotive amid elves and Yeti, and an authority figure investigates the Globe of Belief's malfunction.

entities.name: Jack
entities.description: A Guardian who takes control of the sleigh, reacts with excitement, and narrowly avoids a collision with a pillar, demonstrating responsiveness under pressure.
entities.summary: A mysterious, invisible figure interacts with Burgess townsfolk while a playful, wind-and-snow-bringing figure joins children, instigating a magical snowball fight and guiding events through ice manipulation and joyful mischief.

entities.name: Bunny
entities.description: A Guardian who expresses surprise when Jack takes the reins and later realizes the teeth are being stolen, showing alarm and solidarity with the team.
entities.summary: A group of Guardians express skepticism toward Jack, questioning his role due to children's lack of belief, while one alerts others about trouble at the Tooth Palace and another hesitates over sleigh travel, highlighting doubts and concerns within the team.

entities.name: Sandy
entities.description: A Guardian who observes the black sand forming shapes, indicating his silent but perceptive role in detecting supernatural phenomena.
entities.summary: A non-verbal Guardian using Dreamsand and subtle gestures alerts others to the Man in Moon's presence and rising tension between Jack and Bunny, while aiding in defense against Nightmares.

entities.name: Tooth
entities.description: A Guardian who is distraught over the theft of her fairies and teeth, later emotionally collapsing before being comforted by the others.
entities.summary: The Guardians, led by a fairy overseeing global tooth collection, protect children's memories tied to teeth; they react to threats like Pitch Black, with one intervening in conflicts to maintain unity.

entities.summary: Small wooden containers holding children's teeth, stored in the chamber and targeted by the Nightmares for theft.

entities.name: Pitch taunts the Guardians from above the platform
entities.description: Pitch's voice echoes in the chamber as he addresses the Guardians from a high vantage point, expressing satisfaction at having gathered them together and referencing his earlier manipulation on the globe.

entities.name: Tooth confronts Pitch and demands the return of her fairies
entities.description: Tooth flies toward Pitch and issues a direct ultimatum, threatening consequences if he does not return her stolen fairies within thirty seconds.

entities.name: Pitch mocks Tooth with a pillow joke
entities.description: Pitch sarcastically responds to Tooth's threat by referencing her role as the Tooth Fairy, asking if she will stick a quarter under his pillow.

entities.name: North questions Pitch's motives for attacking
entities.description: North demands to know why Pitch is carrying out his actions, prompting Pitch to reveal his desire to be believed in like the other Guardians.

entities.name: Pitch declares his weariness of hiding under beds
entities.description: Pitch expresses resentment over his role as the Bogeyman, stating he is tired of living in fear and hiding in the shadows beneath children's beds.

entities.name: Bunny insults Pitch and calls him a shadow sneaking ratbag
entities.description: Bunny responds to Pitch's provocations with hostility, accusing him of cowardice and challenging him to face them directly.

entities.name: Pitch appears upside down beneath the platform to taunt Bunny
entities.description: Pitch startlingly reveals himself hanging upside down below the platform, directly confronting Bunny before vanishing again into the shadows.

entities.name: Pitch acknowledges Jack Frost and comments on his neutrality
entities.description: Pitch notices Jack among the Guardians, laughs at his inclusion, and states he will ignore him, adding a jab about Jack being used to being overlooked.

entities.name: Jack denies being allied with the Guardians
entities.description: When Pitch suggests Jack is now part of the Guardian group, Jack quickly clarifies that he is not friends with them, maintaining his stance as an outsider.

entities.name: Bunny chases Pitch who evades by teleporting between columns
entities.description: Bunny lunges after Pitch in anger, but Pitch disappears and reappears on a distant column, using the environment to evade capture.

entities.name: Tooth attacks Pitch with Bunny's boomerang in a rage
entities.description: Tooth, enraged, grabs one of Bunny's boomerangs and lunges at Pitch with a scream, attempting to strike him.

entities.name: Nightmare emerges to block Tooth's attack
entities.description: Just as Tooth is about to reach Pitch, a large Nightmare bursts from hiding and rears up in front of her, forcing her to fall back in fear.

entities.name: Baby Tooth hides in Jack's tunic out of fear
entities.description: Overcome with fear during the confrontation, Baby Tooth flees to Jack and takes shelter inside his tunic.

entities.name: Jamie's greyhound detects Bunnymund's scent and confronts him
entities.description: Jamie's greyhound, Greyhound, wakes up suddenly, senses Bunnymund, and moves aggressively toward him, coming nose to nose with the Easter Bunny.

entities.name: Jack sets off an alarm clock with his staff
entities.description: Jack stealthily uses his staff to trigger an alarm clock on a bedside table, causing it to ring loudly and startle Bunnymund.

entities.name: Bunnymund flees from the greyhound in panic
entities.description: Startled by the alarm, Bunnymund runs away in fear, with the greyhound chasing him closely, both running in circles around the room.

entities.name: Sandy creates a Dreamsand baseball to stop the dog
entities.description: Sandy forms a baseball made of Dreamsand in an attempt to calm or stop the greyhound during the chaotic chase.

entities.name: Sandy loses control of the Dreamsand baseball
entities.description: As the greyhound brushes past Sandy, he fumbles the Dreamsand baseball, causing it to go flying unpredictably into the room.

entities.name: Greyhound knocks North backward during the chase
entities.description: While running past North, the greyhound collides with him, causing North to stumble and fall back.

entities.name: Greyhound crashes into Sandy and releases Dreamsand
entities.description: The greyhound accidentally smacks into Sandy, disrupting his control and causing the Dreamsand to scatter across the room.

entities.name: Dreamsand strikes Tooth and transforms into a golden tooth
entities.description: A burst of Dreamsand hits Tooth in the face, explodes into golden dust, and coalesces into a golden tooth above her and her fairy's heads.

entities.name: Bunnymund inhales Dreamsand and sees a carrot illusion
entities.description: Bunnymund catches a whiff of the airborne Dreamsand, which triggers a hallucination of a carrot appearing in front of him.

entities.name: Bunnymund collapses asleep after inhaling Dreamsand
entities.description: Overcome by the Dreamsand, Bunnymund falls unconscious with a loud thud.

entities.name: Greyhound falls asleep from Dreamsand exposure
entities.description: The greyhound is overcome by the Dreamsand and suddenly collapses into sleep alongside Bunnymund.

entities.name: North is overwhelmed by Dreamsand and falls onto Jamie's bed
entities.description: North is caught in the spreading Dreamsand, sees visions of candy canes, and loses consciousness, falling heavily onto the end of Jamie's bed.

entities.name: Jamie is launched into the air by North's fall
entities.description: The force of North landing on the bed catapults Jamie upward, causing him to yell as he flies through the air.

entities.name: Jamie lands in Sandy's arms and is put back to sleep
entities.description: Jamie safely lands in Sandy's arms, begins to wake again, but is immediately re-sedated by Sandy using a puff of Dreamsand.

entities.name: Jack and Sandy observe the aftermath of the chaos
entities.description: Jack and Sandy look down at the sleeping Jamie and then survey the room filled with unconscious, snoring figures, expressing quiet amusement.

entities.name: Sandy discovers a Nightmare behind Jack
entities.description: As Sandy looks around, he suddenly notices a Nightmare lurking behind Jack, signaling a new threat.

entities.name: DreamSand creates dancing carrot and candy cane illusions
entities.description: After everyone falls asleep, Dreamsand forms playful, dancing images of a carrot and candy canes above the heads of Bunnymund and North.

entities.name: Jamie's room
entities.description: A small bedroom where the chaotic chase between Bunnymund and the greyhound takes place, containing a bed, dresser, and bedside table.

entities.name: that night
entities.description: A relative temporal anchor indicating the events occur during the night in Jamie's home.

entities.name: Bunnymund
entities.description: A large, anthropomorphic rabbit and one of the Guardians, known for his agility, combat skills, and connection to Easter traditions.
entities.summary: Guardians, including a rabbit-like figure and Jack, navigate conflicts and rivalries in cold environments, confront Pitch defiantly, react to threats and sleigh rides, and engage in a playful rooftop race in Shanghai.

entities.name: Jack
entities.description: A youthful, mischievous spirit and Guardian associated with winter and ice, wielding a staff and capable of creating frost.
entities.summary: A mysterious, invisible figure interacts with Burgess townsfolk while a playful, wind-and-snow-bringing figure joins children, instigating a magical snowball fight and guiding events through ice manipulation and joyful mischief.

entities.name: Sandy
entities.description: The Sandman, a small, golden figure who uses Dreamsand to induce sleep and create illusions, communicating non-verbally.
entities.summary: A non-verbal Guardian using Dreamsand and subtle gestures alerts others to the Man in Moon's presence and rising tension between Jack and Bunny, while aiding in defense against Nightmares.

entities.name: Tooth
entities.description: The Tooth Fairy, a winged, avian-humanoid figure responsible for collecting children's teeth and remembering their memories.
entities.summary: The Guardians, led by a fairy overseeing global tooth collection, protect children's memories tied to teeth; they react to threats like Pitch Black, with one intervening in conflicts to maintain unity.

entities.name: North
entities.description: Also known as Santa Claus, a large, bearded Guardian who commands a workshop at the North Pole and embodies wonder and gift-giving.
entities.summary: Guardians convene at the North Pole after an urgent summons regarding Pitch Black's return and the threat to children, while a central figure works on an ice locomotive amid elves and Yeti, and an authority figure investigates the Globe of Belief's malfunction.

entities.name: Jamie
entities.description: A young boy who still believes in the Guardians and serves as a key connection between the magical world and childhood faith.
entities.summary: A young boy believes in cryptids, loses a tooth in a sledding accident, dreams of snowball fights, and interacts with friends and family, while another boy walks on a frozen pond and drops his book in the wind.

entities.name: Abbey
entities.description: Jamie's greyhound, a large dog who reacts strongly to scents and becomes involved in the chaotic encounter with Bunnymund.

entities.name: Wooden Staff
entities.description: Jack's magical wooden staff, used to channel ice powers and interact with objects, such as setting off an alarm clock.
entities.summary: Jack Frost's magical wooden staff channels ice powers, generating frost, freezing effects, and wind blasts; used offensively, environmentally, and interactively.

entities.name: alarm clock
entities.description: A bedside clock that Jack triggers with his staff, causing a loud ringing sound that startles Bunnymund.

entities.name: Dreamsand
entities.description: Golden sand created and manipulated by Sandy that induces sleep and forms illusions when released into the air.
entities.summary: Golden sand created by Sandy carries dreams, induces sleep, and forms illusions or messages in the air, transforming into shapes like a dolphin or a child playing soccer before disappearing.

entities.name: Pitch
entities.summary: A shadowy creature linked to Pitch evades Jack, scales walls, and patrols the city, threatening the Guardians during their escape.

entities.name: Guardians
entities.description: A group of mythical protectors, including Santa, the Easter Bunny, the Tooth Fairy, and the Sandman, who defend childhood beliefs and wonders.
entities.summary: A group of legendary protectors—North, Tooth, Bunnymund, and Sandy—defend children's beliefs, hopes, and dreams, guided by the Moon, and have appointed Jack Frost as a new member to combat threats to childhood wonder.

entities.description: A physical opening in a structure through which Jack sees the Nightmare and jumps out, serving as a scene anchor for the action.

entities.name: Jack removes his ice-skate and stands barefoot on the frozen pond

entities.description: A young girl, Jack's sister, remains motionless on the cracking ice of a frozen pond, visibly terrified as the surface begins to splinter under her skates.

entities.name: Jack sincerely promises to keep his sister safe
entities.description: Jack acknowledges his playful nature but makes a solemn promise that this time is different, vowing to keep his sister safe and asking her to believe in him.

entities.name: Jack's sister smiles through fear after trusting Jack's reassurance
entities.description: After a moment of hesitation, Jack's sister responds to his calm and promise by smiling slightly, choosing to trust him despite the perilous situation.

entities.description: Jack's demeanor shifts dramatically, projecting confidence and inner strength, masking the dire reality of the situation with a sense of playful determination.

entities.name: Tooth
entities.description: A Guardian with wings who regains strength and flies past cheering children, visibly amazed by her renewed energy.
entities.summary: The Guardians, led by a fairy overseeing global tooth collection, protect children's memories tied to teeth; they react to threats like Pitch Black, with one intervening in conflicts to maintain unity.

entities.name: North
entities.description: A Guardian who reacts to Tooth's resurgence by drawing his scimitars and later summons creatures using magic snowglobes.
entities.summary: Guardians convene at the North Pole after an urgent summons regarding Pitch Black's return and the threat to children, while a central figure works on an ice locomotive amid elves and Yeti, and an authority figure investigates the Globe of Belief's malfunction.

entities.name: Pitch
entities.description: An antagonist who commands Nightmares to attack the Guardians and reacts with anger to their resistance.

entities.name: Bunny
entities.description: A small rabbit form of Bunnymund who attempts to transform and is chased by a Nightmare.
entities.summary: A group of Guardians express skepticism toward Jack, questioning his role due to children's lack of belief, while one alerts others about trouble at the Tooth Palace and another hesitates over sleigh travel, highlighting doubts and concerns within the team.

entities.name: Bunnymund
entities.description: A Guardian in rabbit form who expresses anticipation for transformation and fear when pursued by a Nightmare.
entities.summary: Guardians, including a rabbit-like figure and Jack, navigate conflicts and rivalries in cold environments, confront Pitch defiantly, react to threats and sleigh rides, and engage in a playful rooftop race in Shanghai.

entities.name: Cupcake
entities.description: A child who cheers for Tooth Fairy during the scene, contributing to the supportive crowd.
entities.summary: Children experience magical winter moments: a tough girl joins snow play after being transformed, another mocks friends, one dreams of a unicorn, a girl delights in indoor snow, a child sleds past laughing, and a believer helps confront Nightmare sand.

entities.name: Monty

entities.summary: Children react with fear, surprise, and excitement to supernatural events and figures like Jack Frost, Tooth, Santa, and Pitch, contributing to the growing belief in the Guardians.

entities.name: Caleb
entities.description: One of the two individuals who react in disbelief to the creatures emerging from the snowglobes.
entities.summary: A group of children, including twins and Jamie's friends, experience magical events during an egg hunt and winter play, with some doubting Jamie's claims while others join him in believing and confronting fantastical elements like the Easter Bunny and Nightmare sand.

entities.name: Claude
entities.description: One of the two individuals who react in disbelief to the creatures emerging from the snowglobes.
entities.summary: A twin boy and one of Jamie's friends participates in Easter and winter activities, expresses skepticism, fear, and surprise, but ultimately believes in the Guardians and joins Jamie against the Nightmare sand.

document_metadata.summary: Pitch, enraged by children's joy and his loss of power, confronts them but is ignored and powerless; realizing he is no longer feared, he flees as the Guardians unite.

document_metadata.title: 119、EXT. POND - THE MOON
document_metadata.summary: Jamie and his friends grow drowsy as Jack departs with the Guardians; Jack embraces Jamie, then joins the sleigh, declaring himself a Guardian as he flies off, leaving Jamie behind with a final snowflake.

entities.name: Jack sees a face on the Moon and smiles
entities.description: Jack looks up at the Moon and perceives a faint, welcoming face, causing him to smile despite the impossibility of it.

entities.name: Tooth flies in to hug Jack
entities.description: Tooth approaches Jack excitedly and lifts him off the ground in an affectionate embrace.

entities.name: Baby Tooth interrupts Jack and Tooth's embrace
entities.description: As Jack and Tooth share a moment, Baby Tooth interjects, causing Tooth to recoil with giddy embarrassment.

entities.name: Jack gently pats Baby Tooth on the face
entities.description: Jack acknowledges Baby Tooth's presence and affectionately touches her on the side of her face.

entities.name: North presents the Guardian oath book
entities.description: North steps forward and is handed the ancient book used for Guardian oaths, which he prepares to read from.

entities.name: Sandy and Bunny exchange a proud look
entities.description: Sandy and Bunny share a moment of mutual pride and confidence as North prepares to administer the oath.

entities.name: North asks Jack to take the Guardian oath
entities.description: North formally asks Jack if he is ready to make his commitment official by taking the Guardian oath.

entities.name: North recites the Guardian oath to Jack
entities.description: North reads from the book, asking Jack to vow to protect the hopes, wishes, and dreams of children for all time.

entities.name: Jack accepts the Guardian oath
entities.description: After a moment of reflection, Jack responds to North with a solemn 'I will,' accepting the responsibilities of a Guardian.

entities.name: North declares Jack a Guardian
entities.description: North announces that Jack Frost is now and forevermore a Guardian, marking the completion of the ceremony.

entities.name: Jamie and the children celebrate Jack's induction
entities.description: Jamie and the other children cheer and shout in joy upon hearing that Jack has become a Guardian.

entities.name: Yetis and eggs join the celebration
entities.description: The Yetis and animated eggs erupt in cheers and excitement alongside the children and Guardians.

entities.name: North hugs and kisses Jack on both cheeks
entities.description: In a show of deep affection and pride, North lifts Jack and kisses him on both cheeks, causing Jack to wince before smiling.

entities.name: An elf imitates North and kisses another elf
entities.description: Inspired by North's gesture, an elf picks up another elf and kisses him, leading to an awkward moment followed by a punch.

entities.name: Fairies form a heart shape and one faints
entities.description: Several fairies hover near Jack, arranging themselves into a heart shape, with one becoming so overwhelmed she faints and falls.

entities.name: Tooth tells the fairies to keep it together
entities.description: Tooth, noticing her fairies becoming overly emotional, gently reprimands them to stay composed.

entities.description: Caleb draws attention to Santa's sleigh, with Monty confirming its identity as it appears in the scene.

entities.summary: A formal gathering of the Guardians and allies to administer the ancient oath and officially welcome Jack Frost as a new member of the Guardians.

entities.name: Jack Frost

entities.summary: A mischievous winter spirit with frosted hair emerges from a pond, observed by a hooded figure chosen by the Man in Moon to become a Guardian, and is later summoned to join the Guardians, linked to frost, wind, and nighttime flights.

entities.name: Tooth
entities.description: The Tooth Fairy, a Guardian responsible for collecting children's teeth and memories, who shows warmth and pride toward Jack.
entities.summary: The Guardians, led by a fairy overseeing global tooth collection, protect children's memories tied to teeth; they react to threats like Pitch Black, with one intervening in conflicts to maintain unity.

entities.name: North
entities.description: Also known as Santa Claus, the leader of the Guardians who presents the oath and formally inducts Jack into the group.
entities.summary: Guardians convene at the North Pole after an urgent summons regarding Pitch Black's return and the threat to children, while a central figure works on an ice locomotive amid elves and Yeti, and an authority figure investigates the Globe of Belief's malfunction.

entities.name: Bunny
entities.description: The Easter Bunny, a Guardian with a tough but supportive demeanor, who expresses pride in Jack's induction.
entities.summary: A group of Guardians express skepticism toward Jack, questioning his role due to children's lack of belief, while one alerts others about trouble at the Tooth Palace and another hesitates over sleigh travel, highlighting doubts and concerns within the team.

entities.name: Sandy
entities.description: The Sandman, a silent Guardian who communicates through golden sand and shares a proud moment with Bunny.
entities.summary: A non-verbal Guardian using Dreamsand and subtle gestures alerts others to the Man in Moon's presence and rising tension between Jack and Bunny, while aiding in defense against Nightmares.

entities.name: Baby Tooth
entities.description: A small, loyal fairy assistant to Tooth who interrupts Jack and Tooth's embrace and receives affection from Jack.
entities.summary: A small fairy, companion to Tooth, survives a Nightmare attack, reunites with her, aids in collecting teeth, and shows concern during their flight and encounters.

entities.name: Jamie
entities.description: A young boy who believes in the Guardians and stands at the center of the group celebrating Jack's induction.
entities.summary: A young boy believes in cryptids, loses a tooth in a sledding accident, dreams of snowball fights, and interacts with friends and family, while another boy walks on a frozen pond and drops his book in the wind.

entities.name: Caleb
entities.description: One of Jamie's friends who points out Santa's sleigh during the celebration.
entities.summary: A group of children, including twins and Jamie's friends, experience magical events during an egg hunt and winter play, with some doubting Jamie's claims while others join him in believing and confronting fantastical elements like the Easter Bunny and Nightmare sand.

entities.name: Monty

entities.summary: Children react with fear, surprise, and excitement to supernatural events and figures like Jack Frost, Tooth, Santa, and Pitch, contributing to the growing belief in the Guardians.

document_metadata.title: 119、EXT. POND - THE MOON
document_metadata.summary: Jamie and his friends grow drowsy as Jack departs with the Guardians; Jack embraces Jamie, then joins the sleigh, declaring himself a Guardian as he flies off, leaving Jamie behind with a final snowflake.

entities.name: North puts hand on Jack's shoulder and signals departure
entities.description: North turns away from Bunny, places his hand on Jack's shoulder, and indicates it is time to leave.

entities.name: Sandy creates shower of Dreamsand over children
entities.description: Sandy raises his hands to generate a glowing shower of Dreamsand that gently drifts down onto the children, delighting them.

entities.name: Children react with awe to Dreamsand display
entities.description: The children exclaim in wonder and admiration at the beauty and magic of the Dreamsand raining down around them.

entities.name: Bunny gives egg to Sophie and bids farewell
entities.description: Bunny hands a decorated egg to Sophie, who giggles and touches his nose, and he affectionately calls her 'little anklebiter' while expressing he will miss her.

entities.name: Sophie says goodbye to Bunny
entities.description: Sophie responds to Bunny's farewell by waving and saying 'Bye, bye, bunny' in a playful and endearing manner.

entities.name: Jamie expresses fear about Guardians leaving
entities.description: Jamie realizes the Guardians are departing and voices concern about what will happen if Pitch returns or if belief fades.

entities.name: Jack reassures Jamie about continued belief
entities.description: Jack kneels to Jamie's level and uses analogies about the sun and moon to comfort him, affirming that the Guardians will always be present, even if unseen.

entities.name: Jack declares Jamie a Guardian
entities.description: Jack tells Jamie that because the Guardians will always be in his heart, Jamie is also a Guardian now, giving him a sense of belonging and purpose.

entities.name: Jack leaves for sleigh after emotional farewell
entities.description: After comforting Jamie, Jack stands up and walks toward the sleigh, preparing to depart with the other Guardians.

entities.name: sleigh
entities.description: A vehicle used by the Guardians, present in the scene where Jack heads toward it after the farewell.

entities.name: that night
entities.description: A relative temporal anchor indicating the time of the Guardians' departure after the events with the children.

entities.name: North
entities.description: A Guardian who signals it's time to leave and departs after the encounter with the children.
entities.summary: Guardians convene at the North Pole after an urgent summons regarding Pitch Black's return and the threat to children, while a central figure works on an ice locomotive amid elves and Yeti, and an authority figure investigates the Globe of Belief's malfunction.

entities.name: Jack
entities.description: A Guardian who reassures Jamie about continued belief and declares him a Guardian before departing.
entities.summary: A mysterious, invisible figure interacts with Burgess townsfolk while a playful, wind-and-snow-bringing figure joins children, instigating a magical snowball fight and guiding events through ice manipulation and joyful mischief.

entities.name: Sandy
entities.description: A Guardian who creates a shower of Dreamsand that delights the children.
entities.summary: A non-verbal Guardian using Dreamsand and subtle gestures alerts others to the Man in Moon's presence and rising tension between Jack and Bunny, while aiding in defense against Nightmares.

entities.name: Bunny
entities.description: A Guardian who gives an egg to Sophie and bids her farewell.
entities.summary: A group of Guardians express skepticism toward Jack, questioning his role due to children's lack of belief, while one alerts others about trouble at the Tooth Palace and another hesitates over sleigh travel, highlighting doubts and concerns within the team.

entities.name: Sophie
entities.description: A young child who receives an egg from Bunny and interacts with him playfully.
entities.summary: Various children interact with the Easter Bunny during festive activities, including egg hunts, painting, and playful encounters, showcasing curiosity and joy in Easter traditions.

entities.name: Jamie
entities.description: A child who expresses fear about the Guardians leaving and is reassured by Jack.
entities.summary: A young boy believes in cryptids, loses a tooth in a sledding accident, dreams of snowball fights, and interacts with friends and family, while another boy walks on a frozen pond and drops his book in the wind.

entities.name: egg
entities.description: A physical item given by Bunny to Sophie as a token during their farewell.

entities.name: Dreamsand
entities.description: A magical sand created by Sandy that induces wonder and joy in children.
entities.summary: Golden sand created by Sandy carries dreams, induces sleep, and forms illusions or messages in the air, transforming into shapes like a dolphin or a child playing soccer before disappearing.

entities.name: Jamie's friends express drowsiness and desire to go home
entities.description: Jamie's friends rub their eyes and voice their sleepiness, discussing the time and their need to return home.

entities.name: Jamie runs to Jack and embraces him
entities.description: Jamie approaches Jack quickly and hugs him tightly, prompting an initially surprised but warm response from Jack.

entities.name: Jack boards the sleigh with the Guardians
entities.description: Jack stands up and enters the sleigh alongside the other Guardians, preparing for departure.

entities.name: North commands the sleigh to depart
entities.description: North shouts 'Hyah!' to initiate the sleigh's takeoff, signaling the Guardians' departure.

entities.name: Sleigh takes off into the sky with Guardians aboard
entities.description: The sleigh lifts off from the ground and ascends into the sky, carrying Jack and the other Guardians away.

entities.name: Jamie runs after the departing sleigh
entities.description: In an emotional attempt to stay close to Jack, Jamie chases the sleigh on foot but eventually stops when he can no longer follow.

entities.name: Children cheer as sleigh departs
entities.description: The children react with excitement and joy, shouting cheers and applause as they watch the Guardians' sleigh fly away.

entities.name: Jack declares himself Guardian in voiceover
entities.description: As the sleigh flies, Jack narrates that his name is Jack Frost and that he is a Guardian, affirming his identity based on the moon's revelation.

entities.name: Guardians celebrate Jack's inclusion with back pats
entities.description: The Guardians acknowledge Jack's new role by patting him on the back in a gesture of camaraderie and acceptance.

entities.description: Jack forms a snowflake in his hand and releases it, sending it drifting forward as a meaningful gesture for Jamie and the audience.
